purpose: Supplement the retained noisy main 18-process wall-time comparison with whole-process CPU consumption; do not replace or exclude any earlier result.
quality: Unchanged default shadows, wind, distance representations, camera and timestep.
process_cpu_scope: Bench executable process CPU time over its entire lifetime, including setup, hashing, frame recording, backend, driver threads charged to the process and teardown; excludes child processes and CPU charged elsewhere. Not per-view CPU time.
elapsed_scopes: OS ExitTime minus StartTime, and observer stopwatch from Process.Start through WaitForExit; reported separately from native per-frame wall intervals.
snapshots: Win32_Processor CurrentClockSpeed/MaxClockSpeed at run start/end are coarse OS-reported MHz, not actual per-core clocks. Recognized competing build/test/benchmark processes (name, PID, start time; no command lines) at start/end and once per WaitForExit(1000) interval, excluding the owned child. Monitor work belongs to the observer and is present for both variants; no per-frame monitor.
per_process_guard: Wait for five seconds without recognized contenders before every predeclared process; retain wait duration and contenders observed while waiting. One outer shared mutex, no nested mutex.
exclusions: None. Retain every completed process and adverse or contended pair, without retry. After each run, wait quiet before the next predeclared process. Execution/invariant failure stops further launches and retains the partial attempt.
mechanism_check: One separately saved frozen-baseline --quick diagnostic validates retained process handle, post-exit total/user/kernel CPU time and independent redirected streams before actual control pairs.
